no_building_admin: No floor plan yet. Draw your first floor in the editor.
save_failed_detail: Saving failed: {error}. Your changes are kept in this browser.
needs_restart: A new version of NeonPlan 3D is installed, but Home Assistant still runs {version}. Please restart Home Assistant – until then saving may fail.
needs_restart_old: A new version of NeonPlan 3D is installed, but Home Assistant still runs an older one. Please restart Home Assistant – until then saving fails.
area_rooms_hint: Adds a room (4 × 3 m) for each area of this floor – then drag it into place and adjust the corners
delete_floor_confirm: Delete floor “{name}” with all its rooms?
pkg_hint: Furniture goes against the room's walls; lamps link to the area's lights. Adjust single items afterwards – Ctrl+Z takes it all back.
pkg_done: {n} items placed – Ctrl+Z takes it back.
pkg_kitchen_row_desc: Row on the back wall with fridge, oven, sink, dishwasher and stove, wall cabinet, dining table with pendant
pkg_kitchen_l_desc: Rows at the back and left, kitchen island with bar stools
pkg_bath_desc: Washbasin, WC, bathtub, washing machine, downlight
pkg_bedroom_desc: Double bed with two nightstands, wardrobe, chest of drawers, ceiling light
pkg_living_desc: TV board, sofa, coffee table, rug, armchair, shelf, floor lamp, plant
pkg_dining_desc: Table with four chairs, sideboard, pendant
pkg_office_desc: Desk with office chair, two shelves, ceiling light
spots_hint: All lamps follow the chosen light (e.g. spots on one dimmer). Afterwards each can be moved and linked to another light like any furniture.
backup_none: None yet. While editing, a restore point is kept at most every 10 minutes.
backup_restore_confirm: Restore the state of {time}? The current state is kept as a restore point.
backup_export_share_hint: Without areas, devices, sensors and images – for passing on to others.
backup_import_confirm: Replace the whole plan with the file? The current state is kept as a restore point.
backup_import_error: The file is no NeonPlan 3D plan ({error}).
backup_hint: Background images are not part of the file.
backup_full_hint: One file with the plan, every background and screen picture and the installed packs. On restore every pack is checked again; the licence key is not included.
backup_full_confirm: Replace the plan, the pictures and the packs with the backup? The current state stays as a restore point.
backup_full_not_backup: This is not a full NeonPlan 3D backup.
backup_full_skipped: Skipped (not verifiable or bound to another installation): {packs}.
device_confirm_hint: A tap in 3D, the quick menu and the room panel ask first. A double tap on the room leaves this device out.
cover_confirm_hint: Open, close and positions ask first in the quick menu and the room panel, and a swipe on the marker no longer moves the blind (it turns the view instead). Stop never asks.
split_handle_hint: Drag: width of the plan and the 3D view
hint_select: Tap a room to select · drag corners · “+” on an edge inserts a corner · arrow keys nudge · Del deletes · Ctrl+Z
hint_polygon: Place corners · tap the first corner or press Enter to close · Esc cancels
overlap_warning: Rooms overlap – walls there are incomplete.
read_only: Only administrators can edit the floor plan.
devices_none_area: Link the room to an area and its devices appear here.
devices_none: The area has no suitable devices.
devices_place_all_confirm: Put {n} devices into the room at once? (Ctrl+Z or “Undo” takes them all back in one step.)
devices_hint: Placed devices appear in 3D. Drag them in the plan to move them.
camera_aim_hint: In the plan the wedge shows where the camera looks. The handle at its tip turns the camera and sets its reach.
panel_no_area: This room is not linked to an area. You can link it in the editor.
panel_empty: No devices of this room are in the plan. In the editor, place devices or pick them for the room panel with ☆.
hold_hint: Tap toggles · long press opens details
panel_unpin: Don't show in the room panel
devices_panel_hint: The room panel shows the devices in the plan. ☆ adds a device to the room panel without placing it.
card_fill_hint: Works best in a dashboard view of the type “Panel (single card)” – the card then takes all the space.
card_floor_thumbs_hint: Small pictures of the floors at the side – tap one to switch
card_floor_thumbs_hint_start: The chosen floor is then where the card starts – the pictures at the side switch to the others
card_pro_hint: Motion trail and weather are Pro add-ons: without the matching add-on these switches have no effect.
card_idle_return: Back to the start view after
card_idle_hint: After the wait the card closes the room and shows the start view again.
card_idle_orbit_hint: After the return the view turns slowly until someone touches the tablet
card_alerts_hint: Smoke, gas, CO, water, alarm panel and windows open in the rain: the room pulses, a note appears at the top
card_alert_jump: Jump to the room of a new warning
card_alert_jump_hint: The view switches to the floor and room of the warning by itself
card_scenes_hint: Scenes and scripts of the area as buttons under the 3D view while a room is selected
card_motion_trail_hint: Where motion was reported in the last 30 minutes, with times (motion, presence and camera sensors)
rain_warning: Warning: window open while it rains
weather_effect_clouds: Clouds dim the sky and the sun
weather_effect_sky: Sun and moon in the sky
weather_entity_hint: The weather entity provides rain, snow, fog and clouds for the 3D view; automatic takes the first one.
weather_hint: Weather outside: rain, snow, fog and clouds from the weather entity, sun and moon from sun.sun
card_weather_hint: Rain, snow, fog and clouds from the first weather entity (weather_entity picks another); only the clouds on the tablet level
trail_hint: Motion trail: where motion was reported in the last 30 minutes, with times
import_error_not_plan: The file is no NeonPlan 3D plan.
card_controls_hint: Tall walls/cut, floors apart and temperature, humidity, CO₂ to switch
card_fullscreen_button_hint: Hides the dashboard around the card (e.g. on a wall tablet)
card_floor_house: Whole house (tap a floor to open it)
card_quality_hint: “Tablet” is the lightest setting – ideal for Fire tablets and other wall tablets.
card_energy: Show energy values at the top
card_room_panel_hint: The room's lights, blinds and cameras in a side panel
card_explode: Pull floors apart in the house view
card_stats_hint: To check how smoothly the card runs on the device
packs_hint: Only packs signed by the publisher can be imported.
lib_badge_light: Lamp: links to a light and switches in 3D
lib_badge_electric: Electric: links to an entity and a power sensor (switching, pictures, consumption)
lib_badge_hint: Items with a symbol link to entities: lamps switch, screens show pictures, appliances show their consumption.
pack_error_wrong_instance: This pack is signed for another Home Assistant installation. The shop account can deliver it for this one.
license_activated: Connected – your packs are listed below.
license_remove_confirm: Disconnect from the shop? Installed packs stay, only updates stop coming by themselves.
license_none: No packs in the account yet.
license_hint: The licence key is in your order and in your account at mastershort.de. Entered once, bought packs appear here, are signed for this installation and update by themselves (checked once a day). Everything installed keeps working without the connection.
license_error_invalid_key: The shop does not know this key. It looks like NP-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX.
license_error_activation_limit: This key is already bound to the allowed number of installations.
license_error_shop_unreachable: The shop cannot be reached right now. Installed packs keep working.
license_error_not_owned: This pack is not in this account.
license_error_wrong_instance: The shop signed the pack for another installation.
pro_feature_camera_cockpit: Camera cockpit: look through the camera and motion trail
offers_loyalty: Your loyalty discount: {percent} % on every further pack and Pro add-on
pack_updated_added: {name} was updated to release {release}: {n} new items – have a look in the library!
ext_intro: Furniture packs and Pro add-ons for NeonPlan 3D. Install what you bought here with your licence key; it updates by itself and works without the connection too.
ext_teaser_text: Furniture packs, the shop connection and Pro add-ons are under \"Extensions\" at the top.
pro_feature_weather: Weather outside: rain, snow, clouds, sun and moon
pro_feature_screens: Live screens: the media player's app colour and artwork, picture rules, camera live pictures on screens
pro_locked: This feature is a Pro add-on. After the purchase it appears under Extensions › Shop connection and installs from there.
pack_remove_confirm: Remove the pack “{name}”? Its furniture stays in the plan as plain boxes.
pack_error_bad_signature: The pack was changed or its signature is invalid.
pack_error_unknown_publisher: This pack is not from a known publisher.
pack_error_not_a_pack: This is not a furniture pack file.
hint_furniture: Tap a room, then pick an item on the right · drag items, resize them by their corners
furniture_into: New items go into the middle of “{room}”.
furniture_pick_room: Tip: tap a room first – new items then land in its middle.
flows_hint: Show or hide glowing lines from the meter to the consumers
hint_opening: Tap a wall to add a door or window – choose its kind on the right afterwards
flip_swing_hint: The door swings into the room or to the other side
hint_measure: Tap the starting point, then type the wall lengths with their direction on the right
measure_start: Tap the starting point in the plan, e.g. a room corner.
measure_from: Start at {x} / {z} m – tapping moves the start.
measure_gap: Gap to the start: {gap} m (joined when closing)
measure_hint: Tip: type a length and press an arrow key. With measured inside dimensions, use “Close gaps” afterwards.
hint_outdoor: Drag to draw an outdoor area (lawn, terrace, pool …)
outdoor_hint: Outdoor lights (path light, garden spot, outdoor wall light) light all outdoor areas and the facade.
north_hint: North is needed for the sun (light through the windows).
roof_sections_hint: Each roof section covers a rectangle of the house, e.g. the house, the barn or an extension – each with its own shape, ridge direction, eave height and pitch. Drag in the plan to draw a new one; tap selects it, dragging moves it, the corners resize it.
roof_sections_start: Create roof sections from the rooms
roof_regen_confirm: Replace all roof sections with a new proposal from the rooms?
roof_section_hint: Heights count from the ground. A side with a lower eave reaches further down (catslide); pent roofs rise from the first side.
roof_open_hint: For a terrace roof or a carport: posts and beams carry the roof instead of walls, and it is see-through. Where the canopy meets the house wall, it rests on the wall.
roof_swap_hint: Turns the roof round: the two sides swap eave and pitch, a pent roof rises the other way.
roof_ridge_short: Along the short side (e.g. terraced house)
gaps_hint: Join rooms up to 60 cm apart at one shared wall; the gap becomes the interior wall thickness.
gaps_closed_wall: {n} places closed, interior wall now {t} m.
hint_garage: Tap a wall to add a garage door
garage_hint: The door follows a garage cover (position or open/closed) or a garage door contact of the room's area.
door_hint: With a door contact the leaf swings open; without a sensor it stands half open.
hint_door: Tap a wall to add a door
hint_window: Tap a wall to add a window
cover_position_invert: Sensor counts the other way round (0 = open)
opening_hint: Sensor type: window contact (reports open/closed), handle sensor (reports open, tilted and closed – e.g. a Homematic window handle) or contact + tilt sensor (a second sensor that only reports tilted). Automatic uses the blinds and contacts of the room's area. Position sensor: an entity reporting the blind's position while it moves (e.g. a Homematic \"level\", 0–100 % or 0–1, open = high) – the blind then moves live in 3D.
fridge_hint: While a door sensor reports open, the door swings open in 3D. The screen on the right door shows pictures by rules like a TV – while that door is closed.
stairwell_hint: A hole in this floor, for example above the staircase or for a gallery; from above you look through it. The opening must lie within one room; several openings may overlap (for an L shape, for example). Stairs on the floor below that reach up here open the floor by themselves as well.
hint_wall: Drag to draw a single wall (partition, half wall) · Shift keeps it straight · Alt without snapping
room_wall_hint: A lower height turns the wall into a parapet or a counter. If two rooms share the wall, the lower setting applies. Windows and doors in it end at the wall height.
free_wall_hint: A free-standing wall, e.g. a partition. Where it meets a room wall, the corner is mitred. Drag the handles to move its ends, drag the line to move the whole wall.
stairwell_outside: This opening reaches across a room boundary and is therefore not cut. Move it fully into one room or make it smaller.
hint_hole: Drag to draw a floor opening (stairwell, gallery)
hint_roof: Drag to draw a roof section · tap selects · drag moves · corners resize
hint_energy: Tap a solar field to select it · drag to move it, also onto another roof face · new fields with + Solar field on the right
parking_no_pack: No vehicle pack imported – vehicles come from the \"Vehicles\" pack (Furniture → Import furniture pack).
parking_hint: Without a sensor the vehicle always stands there. With one it appears as soon as the sensor reports \"on\", \"home\" or \"present\". A vehicle type sensor (e.g. from an AI camera analysis) picks the model: when its state matches a mapping – also as a word in the text – that vehicle is shown, otherwise the default one.
parking_too_tall: The vehicle ({car} m) is taller than the room ({room} m).
robot_hint: While the robot cleans in Home Assistant it drives lanes in 3D through the room it reports (a “current room” sensor, matched by room or area name), else through the room of its dock. The track is simulated – Home Assistant usually does not know the exact position. It drives back to the dock when it returns.
lamp_hint: Tap the lamp in 3D to switch it, long press for the quick menu. Switches work too (e.g. a relay for the ceiling light) – the lamp shines while it is on. Table lamps stand on the furniture below them.
lamp_hint_pendant: Height = drop below the ceiling. Tap in 3D to switch, long press for details.
side_pin_hint: Pinned, the sidebar stays open; otherwise it folds away beside the 3D view while nothing is selected
d_hint: Live 3D next to the plan: drag and turn furniture and devices there – with undo, saved with the plan
furnish_hint: Drag furniture, lamps and devices · furniture snaps to walls · tap one to turn it, set its height and mount
heat_none_found: No matching sensors in the rooms' areas.
solar_hint: Put modules on the roof: they lie in the slope of the roof face; on a flat roof they stand on frames. Drag a field in the plan to move it.
solar_no_roof: Solar fields need a roof: a gable or flat roof under Settings, or roof sections here in the Roof tool.
solar_partial: only {n} of {total} fit on the face
solar_form_hint: Modules that would reach beyond the roof face are left out. “Fill face” puts as many modules on the roof as fit. kWp counted with 400 W per module.
roof_windows_hint: Roof windows lie in the roof face, with a blind and contacts like windows. Drag them in the plan, also onto another roof face.
roof_window_hint: Open, the sash swings out, hinged at the top; tilted, a little; the blind comes down over the glass from the top.
solar_string_inverter_missing: No inverter in the plan yet (Furniture \u2192 Energy & solar)
solar_string_hint: Fields in the same string belong together, also on different roofs (e.g. 5 modules on the house and 5 on the garage). Sensor and inverter count for the whole string.
solar_face_size: Roof face {w} × {h} m (along the eave × up the slope)
solar_cols_hint: One number for rows of equal length, or a list for rows of their own: “4, 4, 3” (from the eave).
solar_pick_hint: Tap a module in the plan to take it away or put it back. Removed ones are dashed.
solar_entity: PV power of this field (e.g. its string)
fix_hint: Fixed: cannot be moved by accident any more (key L, right-click or long press)
fixed_drag_hint: 🔒 Fixed – release it first to move it (lock in the form, right-click or key L)
fixed_delete_confirm: This item is fixed. Delete it anyway?
lock_plan_hint: Lock the floor plan: rooms, walls, doors, windows and outdoor areas cannot be moved by accident. Furniture and devices stay free.
climate_hint: These sensors count for the heatmap and the room panel. “Automatic” takes the sensors of the area and the ones placed in the room, but no device temperatures (3D printer, heat pump, flow …).
opening_mark_hint: A highlighted window or door glows warm. \u201cWhen closed\u201d needs a contact; without a sensor nothing is highlighted.
marker_show_hint: Automatic follows the None / Important / All switch of the 3D view. Always show and Hide apply regardless (except with None).
furn_links_hint: With a power sensor the item shows its watts and gets an energy cable.
screen_pictures_hint: The state or an attribute of the entity is compared (e.g. a TV's app_name). A value matches when it is equal or contained in the text (\"youtube\" matches \"com.google.android.youtube.tv\"); \"*\" = always. The first matching rule wins. Pictures are stored scaled to 512 px; a picture URL or a camera works too – a camera's live picture is refreshed every 5 seconds while shown. Without a matching rule the screen shows the media player.
picture_attribute: Compare the state or an attribute
furn_links_hint_tv: The screen glows while the TV is on, in the colour of the app (Netflix, YouTube …); the label shows the app or title.
stairs_hint: The stair rises towards the back (away from the marked front edge) and opens the ceiling of the floor above.
energy_meter_hint: Tap the spot of the meter or house connection in the plan.
energy_hint: Consumers are placed devices with a power sensor (W) – the sensor itself or one of the same device.
hint_meter: Tap the spot of the meter
presence_hint: Room sensor per person (e.g. ESPresense, Bermuda): its state names the room or area.
